projectDescription: A standalone Bitcoin payment app for Android that runs a full node, requiring no centralized backend.
keyFeatures: Standalone Bitcoin node — no centralized backend required
HD wallet with BIP-32 deterministic key derivation
Native SegWit (Bech32) and Taproot (Bech32m) address support
Offline payments via NFC and Bluetooth
Encrypted wallet backups to Google Drive / Storage Access Framework
Paper wallet sweeping (including BIP-38 password-protected keys)
Dynamic network fees with economic, normal, and priority categories
Exchange rate display via CoinGecko (BTC, mBTC, µBTC, sat denominations)
Network monitor with peer and block list
Spending PIN protection with scrypt key derivation
publicApiSurface: WalletApplication — Application singleton managing wallet lifecycle
BlockchainService — Background service for P2P node and blockchain sync
WalletActivity — Main activity (transaction list, balance, QR address)
SendCoinsActivity — Send payment flow with fee selection
RequestCoinsActivity — Generate payment request QR / URI
SweepWalletActivity — Sweep paper wallet private keys
NetworkMonitorActivity — Inspect connected peers and recent blocks
